'''Team 5''' (also written Team Five and team5) is a modern Star Wars CCG playtest team. Players Committee wraps and Holotheatre interviews name [[Hayes Hunter]], [[Joe Olson]], and [[Phil Aasen]] as members. In 2021 Hayes also named [[Kyle Krueger]] and [[Cal Aldred]] in the same teammate sentence.<ref name="pc-2021nats">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/swccg-returns-to-live-major-events-olson-wins-us-nationals/ SWCCG Returns to Live Major Events; Olson wins US Nationals], Players Committee (19 July 2021)</ref><ref name="ht29">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VVrmnkpvghk Holotheatre Ep 29: What's Hayes Got To Do With It?], Star Wars CCG (28 July 2021)</ref><ref name="bwc2026">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-01-boston-winter-classic-boston-massachusetts-jan-10-to-11-2026/ 2026 Boston Winter Classic wrap], Players Committee</ref>

The published 14 September 2025 roster is Olson's forum spreadsheet.<ref name="forum-81218">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=81218 SWCCG Teams - Rosters], Joe Olson (arebelspy), Players Committee Forums (21 July 2022; spreadsheet updated 14 September 2025). Live sheet: [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1sm2eRljZ3MNMBMPCJpADTFzFXbuy5jjfVrTb9BCzBC4/edit?usp=sharing Google Sheets]. Wayback: https://web.archive.org/web/20261008235350/https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1sm2eRljZ3MNMBMPCJpADTFzFXbuy5jjfVrTb9BCzBC4/edit?usp=sharing. Wiki copy: [[:File:SWCCG Teams Rosters 14 September 2025.txt]].</ref>

== Results ==


At the 2021 U.S. Nationals in Denver, Olson won the title. Hayes finished second, conceding the final to teammate Olson.<ref name="pc-2021nats" />

Hayes told Holotheatre after the 2023 U.S. Nationals that Team 5 had three in the Top 8 and almost four, and that New Allies also had three, with a first-round team-kill (Hayes vs Joe; Sam vs Charlie).<ref name="ht-s4e14">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bBRVy8vgDFg Holotheatre S4 E14: Nationals Recap with Hayes], Star Wars CCG (5 April 2023)</ref>

At the [[2023 World Championship]] Hayes defeated Casey Anis in the final. The quarterfinals included Hayes vs Joe (team-kill).<ref name="pc-2023w">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2023-world-championship-wrap-up-hayes-hunter-secures-his-first-crown/ 2023 World Championship Wrap-Up], Players Committee (24 August 2023)</ref>

Later PC wraps that print the team name:

* 2025 Las Vegas Grand Prix — "Team 5 member Joe Olson"
* 2026 Boston Winter Classic — "Team 5 member Phil"
* 2026 San Diego Super Open — "Team 5 member Joe"
* 2026 U.S. Nationals — "Team 5 member Hayes"; Olson and Aasen also Top 8<ref name="pc-2026nats">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-us-nationals-wrap-up-win-for-hayes-hunter/ 2026 US Nationals Wrap-Up], Players Committee</ref>
